answer: A new identity serves a probation of 4 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the dune queue naming the kernel that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, each extra identity costs 4 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the dawn record publishes exactly who is still on probation. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
